en.name: Riot
en.ability: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.

revisions.v1: Nominees die, but may nominate again immediately (on day 3, they must). After day 3, evil wins. [All Minions are Riot]
revisions.v2024-12: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.

zh.name: 暴乱
zh.ability: 在第三个白天，所有爪牙会变成暴乱，当天被提名的玩家会立即死亡且必须再次提名一名存活的玩家。

revisions.v1: 被提名的玩家会死亡，但可以立即再次发起提名（在第三个白天，他们必须这么做）。第三个白天后，邪恶阵营获胜。[所有爪牙都是暴乱]
revisions.v2024-12: 在第三个白天，所有爪牙会变成暴乱，当天被提名的玩家会立即死亡且必须再次提名一名存活的玩家。
